purpose: development-only spatial baseline diagnostics; not an official gate rerun

variants.baseline_a: frozen exp(-distance/1000m), fair-blurred using protocol jitter
variants.baseline_b: frozen protocol time-and-wind ellipse; unmodified and fair-blurred
variants.cell2fire: mean of saved exact-horizon Boolean member grids; no simulator rerun
variants.time_wind_frozen_b: independent implementation parity check of unchanged frozen Baseline B; not a novel formula

wind_directional_asymmetric.formula: one-sided downwind decay; upwind/crosswind scale L
wind_directional_asymmetric.Ldown: L * (1 + 1.0 per m/s * mean wind speed)
wind_directional_asymmetric.justification: uses Baseline B's frozen elongation coefficient but applies it only downwind; separates directionality from the frozen centered, 180-degree-symmetric ellipse

decision_reference: better AP of frozen Baseline A/B only; experimental comparisons do not change official gate
